_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY — NOT DEPLOYED. Dedicated exact-byte lock-attestation SIGNER lane (agent.exact_byte_attestation_job), a single-replica ALWAYS-ON worker. Railway's native cron is documented as 5-minute-minimum and best-effort, which cannot keep a <=300s signed envelope fresh, so this worker owns its cadence: it refreshes immediately on start and then about every AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_ATTESTATION_REFRESH_SECONDS (default 60, clamped 10..240). It renews the FRESH (<=300s) Ed25519-signed lock/serving attestation envelope and publishes it to the PRIVATE MUTABLE R2 CONTROL bucket, which is separate from the locked media bucket; the publisher service holds only a read-only control token plus the pinned administrator public key and re-fetches the control object on every verification (agent/exact_byte_runtime.py, AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_ATTESTATION_SOURCE=r2-control). This signer alone holds the Cloudflare lock-read token (R2_API_TOKEN), the media read credentials (R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID/R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY), the control WRITE credentials (AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_CONTROL_R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) and the Ed25519 signing seed (ECHO_LOCK_SIGNING_KEY). Deploy as ONE replica: the worker holds an exclusive in-flight flock for its whole lifetime, so an overlapping second worker skips and exits. Each cycle is bounded (3 attempts, 2s/4s backoff) and fail-closed: the seed-derived public key is required to equal the pinned administrator public key BEFORE upload (wrong or missing pin: zero uploads), envelope freshness is validated pre-upload and on readback (integer non-bool timestamps, observed_at <= now, age <=300s, expires_at > now, remaining TTL >=60s), and the envelope is locally verified against the pinned identity and derived public key, then read back with exact byte identity, signature/schema/identity re-verification and >=60s remaining TTL proof. A failed cycle is logged and the worker keeps running; it never silently exits on transient refresh failures, and the publisher's stale-envelope hold is never extended. SIGTERM/SIGINT stop it gracefully (exit 0); restartPolicyType ON_FAILURE only restarts it on a crash. Everything defaults OFF: before any use an operator must set AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_ATTESTATION_JOB_ENABLED=true and provision the pinned media identity (AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_R2_ACCOUNT_ID/AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_R2_BUCKET/AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL), AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_PROBE_KEY, AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_SERVING_EVIDENCE_PATH, the publisher-pinned administrator public key (AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_ADMIN_PUBLIC_KEY_B64, which must equal the seed-derived key or the worker refuses with zero uploads), the control identity (AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_CONTROL_R2_ACCOUNT_ID/AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_CONTROL_R2_BUCKET/AGENT_EXACT_BYTE_CONTROL_OBJECT_KEY) and the four secrets above. See docs/EXACT_BYTE_ATTESTATION_TRANSPORT.md. No production values are provisioned here.
